title: Starship’s 13th Test Flight Ends With a Lucky Splashdown
summary: SpaceX’s giant Starship rocket launched for its 13th time on Friday, notched two planned tests in space, and then had a lucky finish to its suborbital space odyssey: Its upper stage survived a powered landing in the Indian Ocean, at least briefly.
